decisions.decision: Removed app.py's trailing unconditional graphql_endpoints import instead of guarding it
decisions.rationale: router_registry already registers it as optional with logged, non-fatal failure; the trailing lines also called include_router on socketio.ASGIApp which has no such method

decisions.decision: ai_assistant_endpoints calls chat() function directly instead of an ai_assistant_service singleton
decisions.rationale: The singleton was a module-level None that nothing initialized — every request would have raised AttributeError

decisions.decision: test_mcp_server.py tests the FastMCP instance (mcp.list_tools/call_tool), not HTTP routes
decisions.rationale: Phase 37 removed the REST-shaped /api/mcp surface; the protocol layer is the real contract. call_tool returns (content, structured) tuple on mcp 1.28 for typed tools.
